oauth_expired.title: BLUETTI authentication expired
oauth_expired.description: Your BLUETTI account authorization has expired. Go to the integration's settings and select **Reconfigure** to sign in again.

websocket_error.title: BLUETTI real-time updates unavailable
websocket_error.description:
The BLUETTI cloud rejected the real-time update connection: {error}

Device data still updates by polling every 30 seconds; this only affects how quickly changes show up. If this persists, try removing and re-adding the integration.

modbus_removed.title: Local Modbus has been removed from this integration
modbus_removed.description:
This integration no longer reads devices over local Modbus. A connection was configured for: {devices}. Its settings and its entities have been removed.

To keep reading these devices on your network, install the dedicated **BLUETTI Modbus** integration. You can dismiss this notice.
